info.title: DSMS API
info.description:
Drone Services Management System — unified Node.js REST API.

- **Total endpoints:** 787
- **Route files:** 68
- **Schema overlays applied:** 322
- **Generated:** 2026-08-20T05:58:47.959Z

**Authentication:** All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Obtain a token via `POST /api/public/login/verify-otp`.
